words:
迷[まよ]う — to get lost; to hesitate — हराउनु; अलमलिनु
迷惑[めいわく] — nuisance, trouble — झन्झट
迷子[まいご] — lost child — हराएको बच्चा
example: どちらを 買[か]うか 迷[まよ]っている。
example_en: I can't decide which one to buy.
component: 辶 + 米 (grains of rice scattered on a road make you lose your way)
confusable: 米 (こめ) — 迷 is 米 with 辶; 送 (おく・る)
tags: N3 kanji batch3 vocab_linked kanji_day22 verb

words:
到着[とうちゃく] — arrival — आगमन
到達[とうたつ] — reaching, attainment — पुग्नु
到底[とうてい] — (not) possibly — कुनै पनि हालतमा (छैन)
example: 飛行機[ひこうき]は 予定[よてい]より 三十分[さんじゅっぷん] 遅[おく]れて 到着[とうちゃく]した。
example_en: The plane arrived thirty minutes behind schedule.
example_ne: विमान तालिकाभन्दा तीस मिनेट ढिलो आइपुग्यो।
component: 至 + 刂 (a sword arriving precisely at its destination)
confusable: 倒 (たお・れる) = 亻 + 到
tags: N3 kanji batch3 vocab_linked kanji_day22 noun

words:
込[こ]む — to be crowded — भीड हुनु
申[もう]し 込[こ]む — to apply — आवेदन दिनु
振[ふ]り 込[こ]む — to transfer (bank) — बैंक ट्रान्सफर गर्नु
込[こ]める — to put (feeling) into — (भावना) राख्नु
example: 朝[あさ]の 電車[でんしゃ]は いつも 込[こ]んでいる。
example_en: The morning train is always crowded.
component: 辶 + 入 (walking straight into a crowded space)
confusable: 入 (はい・る) — 込 is 入 with 辶
tags: N3 kanji batch3 vocab_linked kanji_day23 verb

kunyomi: か・ける / か・かる
words:
掛[か]ける — to hang; to put on (glasses); to make (a call) — झुन्ड्याउनु; लगाउनु
掛[か]かる — to hang; to take (time/money) — लाग्नु
腰掛[こしか]ける — to sit down — बस्नु
出[で] 掛[か]ける — to go out — बाहिर जानु
example: コートを ハンガーに 掛[か]けてください。
example_en: Please hang your coat on the hanger.
component: 扌 + 圭 + 卜 (a hand hanging a tablet on a divination post)
confusable: 街 (まち) shares 圭
tags: N3 kanji batch3 vocab_linked kanji_day23 verb

kunyomi: か・える / か・わる
words:
着替[きが]える — to change clothes — कपडा फेर्नु
両替[りょうがえ] — currency exchange — पैसा साट्ने
取[と]り 替[か]える — to replace — साट्नु
替[か]わる — to be replaced — साटिनु
example: 空港[くうこう]で 円[えん]を ドルに 両替[りょうがえ]した。
example_en: I exchanged yen for dollars at the airport.
component: 夫 + 夫 + 日 (two men taking turns replacing each other day by day)
confusable: 変[か]える (change nature) / 代[か]える (substitute) / 替[か]える (swap) — all read かえる
disc_front: Which かえる is 'swap for an equivalent'? 円をドルに＿える
disc_note: 替 = swap one thing for an equivalent (両替, 着替え). 変 = change in nature (変化). 代 = substitute on behalf of (代わりに).
tags: N3 kanji batch3 vocab_linked kanji_day23 verb confusable

kunyomi: たの・む / たよ・る
words:
頼[たの]む — to ask, request — अनुरोध गर्नु
頼[たよ]る — to rely on — भर पर्नु
依頼[いらい] — request (formal) — अनुरोध
信頼[しんらい] — trust — भरोसा
example: 友達[ともだち]に 引[ひ]っ 越[こ]しの 手伝[てつだ]いを 頼[たの]んだ。
example_en: I asked a friend to help me move.
component: 束 + 頁 (carrying a bundle on one's head, relying on others to help)
confusable: 願 (ねが・う) also ends in 頁; 束 (たば)
tags: N3 kanji batch3 vocab_linked kanji_day23 verb

words:
逆[ぎゃく] — reverse, opposite — उल्टो
逆[ぎゃく]に — conversely — उल्टै
逆[さか]らう — to go against — विरोध गर्नु
逆転[ぎゃくてん] — reversal — उल्टो हुनु
example: 地図[ちず]を 逆[ぎゃく]に 見[み]ていた。
example_en: I was looking at the map upside down.
component: 辶 + 屰 (an upside-down person walking in the reverse direction)
tags: N3 kanji batch3 vocab_linked kanji_day23 noun

kunyomi: さいわ・い / しあわ・せ
words:
幸[しあわ]せ — happiness — खुसी
幸福[こうふく] — happiness (formal) — सुख
幸運[こううん] — good luck — भाग्य
幸[さいわ]い — fortunately — भाग्यवश
example: 家族[かぞく]と 過[す]ごす 時間[じかん]が 一番[いちばん] 幸[しあわ]せだ。
example_en: Time spent with family is the happiest.
example_ne: परिवारसँग बिताएको समय सबैभन्दा खुसीको हो।
component: 土 + ￥ (finding wealth buried in the earth brings happiness and luck)
confusable: 辛 (から・い, spicy / hard) — one stroke different; 達 has 幸 inside
disc_front: Which kanji means 'happiness'? ＿せ
disc_note: 幸 has 土 on top. 辛 has 立 on top — spicy / painful (辛い). One stroke separates them. 苦 = suffering.
tags: N3 kanji batch3 vocab_linked kanji_day24 noun adj confusable

words:
昔[むかし] — long ago, old days — उहिले
昔話[むかしばなし] — old tale — पुरानो कथा
大昔[おおむかし] — ancient times — धेरै पहिले
example: 昔[むかし]は この 辺[へん]に 何[なに]も なかった。
example_en: Long ago there was nothing around here.
component: 廿 + 日 (twenty suns and days passed, referring to long ago)
confusable: 借 (か・りる) = 亻 + 昔; 惜 (お・しい) = 忄 + 昔
disc_front: Which kanji means 'long ago'? ＿はここに何もなかった
disc_note: 昔 is bare — old days. 借 has 亻 — borrow (借りる). 惜 has 忄 — regrettable (惜しい).
tags: N3 kanji batch3 vocab_linked kanji_day24 noun confusable

words:
若[わか]い — young — जवान
若者[わかもの] — young people — युवा
若[も]し — if — यदि
若手[わかて] — young (staff) — जवान कर्मचारी
example: 若[わか]いうちに いろいろな 経験[けいけん]を したほうがいい。
example_en: You should have many experiences while you're young.
example_ne: जवान हुँदै विभिन्न अनुभव गर्नु राम्रो।
component: 艹 + 右 (young sprouts picked by hand on the right)
confusable: 右 (みぎ); 苦 (くる・しい) = 艹 + 古
disc_front: Which kanji means 'young'? ＿い
disc_note: 若 = 艹 + 右. 苦 = 艹 + 古 — suffering (苦しい). 右 = right.
tags: N3 kanji batch3 vocab_linked kanji_day24 adj confusable

kunyomi: お・いる / ふ・ける
words:
老人[ろうじん] — elderly person — वृद्ध
老[お]いる — to grow old — बूढो हुनु
老後[ろうご] — one's old age — बुढेसकाल
example: 日本[にほん]では 老人[ろうじん]の 数[かず]が 増[ふ]えている。
example_en: The number of elderly people in Japan is increasing.
component: 耂 + 匕 (an elder leaning on a cane in old age)
confusable: 考 (かんが・える) = 耂 + 丂; 者 (もの) = 耂 + 日
disc_front: Which kanji means 'old age'? ＿人
disc_note: 老 has 匕 underneath. 考 has 丂 (考える). 者 has 日 (person).
tags: N3 kanji batch3 vocab_linked kanji_day24 noun confusable

words:
命[いのち] — life — जीवन, प्राण
生命[せいめい] — life (biological) — जीवन
命令[めいれい] — order, command — आदेश
一生懸命[いっしょうけんめい] — with all one's might — पूरा मेहनतले
運命[うんめい] — fate — नियति
example: 医者[いしゃ]は 患者[かんじゃ]の 命[いのち]を 救[すく]った。
example_en: The doctor saved the patient's life.
component: 亼 + 口 + 卩 (a leader giving an authoritative life-or-death order to a kneeling subject)
confusable: 令 (れい) — 命 is 令 with 口; 冷 (つめ・たい) = 冫 + 令
disc_front: Which kanji means 'life'? ＿を救う
disc_note: 命 has 口 on the left under 人. 令 has no 口 (命令 uses both). 冷 has 冫 (冷たい).
